umferd.name: Umferð — Vegagerðin traffic counters
umferd.notes: GeoServer WFS 1.0.0, no auth. Key layers: gis:umferdvika_2021_1 (real-time 15-min counts, ~254 features), gis:umf_talningar_stefnugreint_stadir (station metadata). Current-state snapshot, not a history — repeat calls to build a time series yourself.

fiskistofa.name: Fiskistofa — fishing closures and areas
fiskistofa.notes: Public Hafsjá GeoServer WFS, no auth. Primary layer virkar_skyndilokanir (active rapid closures); other virk_*/virkar_* layers cover regulations and spawning/fishing-area restrictions. Paid catch/quota data (Gagnaveita) is deliberately excluded upstream and not covered here.

ust-gis.name: UST GIS — Environment Agency spatial catalogue
ust-gis.publisher: Umhverfis- og orkustofnun (Environment and Energy Agency)
ust-gis.notes: GeoServer WFS, no auth. INSPIRE:mengadur_jardvegur is the contaminated-land registry (confirmed + suspected + historical sites — not a remediation count). Coordinates/risk class can be null on otherwise valid rows.

lmi.name: LMI — Landmælingar Íslands national geodata
lmi.notes: GeoServer WFS 2.0.0, no auth. base_url has a {workspace} placeholder — pass the full layer as 'WORKSPACE:LayerName' (e.g. 'ERM:Landmask') to get_geodata and this tool substitutes the workspace itself. Workspaces: ERM (topographic, 1:250k), EBM (admin boundaries, 1:100k), ni (Náttúrufræðistofnun geology/nature), LMI_vektor (municipalities/hazards), LHG (maritime).

natt.name: Náttúrufræðistofnun — vector geodata
natt.publisher: Náttúrufræðistofnun Íslands (Icelandic Institute of Natural History)
natt.notes: GeoServer WFS 2.0.0, no auth, EPSG:3057 native (ISN93/LCC Iceland) — pass srs='EPSG:3057' unless you specifically want WGS84 reprojection. Layer as 'workspace:LayerName'. This GeoServer also federates layers from LMI/Hagstofa/Skógræktin. Note: the national habitat-type map (vistgerðir 3rd edition) is raster-only since 2026 (its vector edition was withdrawn) and is NOT reachable through this WFS tool — it needs WCS/GeoTIFF retrieval, out of scope for a feature-returning tool like get_geodata.

hagstofan.name: Hagstofa Íslands — PX-Web statistics API
hagstofan.notes: No auth. Workflow: search_hagstofa_tables (keyword search over a cached crawl of the whole folder tree, ~2,100 tables — PX-Web v1 has no search; /api/v2 does not exist on this host) -> get_hagstofa_table_info (variables + valid values, from a GET on the table path) -> get_hagstofa_table_tool. get_hagstofa_table takes a full, exact table path (e.g. 'Efnahagur/visitolur/1_vnv/1_vnv/VIS01000.px' for CPI, or 'Efnahagur/thjodhagsreikningar/landsframl/1_landsframleidsla/THJ01103.px' for GDP) and optional PX-Web filters — folder segments are Icelandic abbreviations, not derivable from a table's title/code, so always discover the path with browse_hagstofa_tables first rather than guessing. browse_hagstofa_tables walks the folder catalog one level at a time (GET on each path level; root uses {dbid,text}, deeper levels use {id,type:'l'|'t',text,[updated]} — this tool normalizes both). Also covers Hagstofa's income-distribution table (TEK01001) — values are typically in thousands of ISK, and PX 'Eining' codes distinguish mean vs. median; check the table's own metadata before treating a value as final. CSV responses' declared Content-Type charset is unreliable per-table (some tables send a UTF-8 BOM body but declare charset=Windows-1252) — get_hagstofa_table checks for the BOM before trusting the header. As of 2026-09-05 this API had a ~1-day outage (2026-09-04) for Hagstofa's office move to Borgartún 26 — a genuine planned outage, not a geo-fencing or code issue; both this and the main hagstofa.is site are unaffected long-term. Selections over 100,000 cells get a 403 (measured: 94,770 OK, 101,088 rejected) — the tool checks the size from table metadata first and suggests filters/last_n_periods. Filters accept codes or exact labels; last_n_periods uses PX-Web's 'top' filter on the time variable. The catalogue index is seeded from hagstofa_catalog.json (rebuild: iceland-context-hagstofa-crawl) and refreshed in the background when >14 days old; the crawl must be sequential (~0.3s spacing) because concurrent requests get 429.

car.name: island.is public vehicle registry
car.notes: Public GraphQL, no auth (same endpoint as this PoC's court-ruling tools). publicVehicleSearch is fuzzy — a partial plate/VIN can return multiple vehicles; some fields are null for older vehicles.

eurostat.name: Eurostat — EU statistics REST API
eurostat.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union / Eurostat
eurostat.notes: No API key. Returns json-stat2; this tool decodes the composite row-major value index into (dimension label -> value) observations. Useful as an EU/euro-area comparison counterpart to Hagstofa series. Discovery: search_eurostat_datasets_tool (cached table of contents, ~8,900 datasets), get_eurostat_dataset_info / get_eurostat_dimension_values (SDMX dataflow with references=descendants&detail=referencepartial -> only codes the dataset actually uses). Time range via sinceTimePeriod/untilTimePeriod/lastTimePeriod. Eurostat silently treats an unknown filter VALUE as 'no filter' (geo=ZZ -> 413 extraction too big), so filters are validated against the dataset's codelists first. Older editions freeze (prc_hicp_midx ends 2025-12; successor prc_hicp_minr) — check data_end.

vedur.name: Veðurstofa Íslands — weather and earthquakes
vedur.notes: No auth, OpenAPI-described. /weather for observations/stations/forecasts, /quakes for seismic events (no equivalent in the old XML API). Prefer this over the legacy xmlweather.vedur.is, which Veðurstofa itself says is superseded. Earthquake queries have no server-side row limit — always bound with start_time.

loftgaedi.name: UST air quality monitoring
loftgaedi.notes: No auth, CORS enabled. 57 stations, hourly PM10/PM2.5/NO2/H2S etc. Values arrive as strings; readings above ~2000 are typically instrument faults.

lanamal.name: Lánamál ríkisins — government bond market
lanamal.notes: No auth, but requires a browser-like User-Agent and a Referer pointing at the matching /markadsyfirlit page (a bare request with no headers is blocked). RIKB (non-indexed) and RIKS (indexed) government bond series. The top-level closingYield can be stale for thinly-traded bonds — this tool surfaces the daily chartData fixing instead as latest_yield_fixing.

rikisreikningur.name: Ríkisreikningur — state accounts actuals
rikisreikningur.publisher: Fjársýsla ríkisins (State Treasury / Financial Management Authority)
rikisreikningur.notes: Small Azure Functions API behind rikisreikningur.is. Requires header X-Api-Key: 6d4d7394-2992-473d-9ea7-45946b39ad9d — this is a static key shipped in the site's own public JS bundle (an anonymous throttling key, not a secret; verified in the vendored skill doc). /api/FJS/Data/* endpoints double-encode their payload: the JSON response is a one-element list containing a JSON-encoded string that must be parsed again — handled by this tool already. Yearly actuals by málefnasvið (policy area, 36 codes 01-36 with gaps).

opnirreikningar.name: Opnir reikningar — government invoice data
opnirreikningar.notes: No auth. Paid invoices by ministry/directorate, 2017-present, monthly updates. Excludes salaries, foreign-currency transactions, benefits, healthcare-provider payments, prisoner payments, security operations, and municipality data (central government only). Pagination has no recordsTotal — page with 'start' until an empty page comes back.

skipulagsmal.name: Skipulagsmál — Planitor planning and building permits
skipulagsmal.notes: Public read API, no auth for the endpoints this tool uses. Covers Reykjavík, Hafnarfjörður and Árborg only (not all Icelandic municipalities). No structured permit-type field in the public API — classification is by free-text/lemma matching on the 'inquiry' field of each minute. OpenAPI spec at planitor.io/openapi.json if you need more than search.

heimsmarkmid.name: Heimsmarkmiðin — Iceland's UN SDG indicators
heimsmarkmid.notes: No auth, static files on GitHub Pages. 137 indicators across all 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals. /is/data/{code}.csv for one indicator's full series (code like '1-1-1' or '16-b-1'); /is/meta/{code}.json for its metadata (source, units). A code can repeat a year when multiple disaggregation rows share it — this is not a duplicate-data bug, it's normal for a disaggregated series.

tenders.name: TED — EU public procurement notices
tenders.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union (Tenders Electronic Daily)
tenders.notes: No auth, POST with a query string (e.g. "organisation-country-buyer=ISL") plus a 'fields' list. Only covers EEA-threshold notices (~1,481 for Iceland) — this tool does not cover OCDS bulk history (2006-2023, CC BY-NC-SA licensed — note that license before redistributing) or domestic sub-threshold tenders (utbodsvefur.is, web-UI only, not covered). Which requested 'fields' actually populate in the response can be inconsistent — this is a thin pass-through of TED's own v3 response shape, not reshaped by this tool.

eea-sdi.name: EEA SDI — European Environment Agency geospatial catalogue
eea-sdi.notes: GeoNetwork 4.4 Elasticsearch search over ~10k EEA38 geospatial datasets (CORINE, Copernicus HRL, Natura 2000, etc.) — no auth. This tool only searches the catalogue (titles/abstracts/years); it does not fetch the underlying data, which is often a large raster hosted on EEA's discomap ArcGIS server or requires a separate free Copernicus Land account.

island-catalogue.name: island.is API catalogue — Straumur/X-Road service directory
island-catalogue.notes: Undocumented internal GraphQL layer (no SLA), no auth. REFERENCE METADATA ONLY — lists ~120 registered web services (owner, access path, declared data sensitivity, OpenAPI docs when published) but never real registry data. Every listed service requires direct X-Road membership to actually call, including ones tagged 'APIGW' (verified: all APIGW-tagged services also carry XROAD, none are self-serve). Ported from a separate PoC (island-is-mcp, same author) — its search_webservices had built a local crawl+cache under the assumption no server-side filter existed; re-verified live before porting that getApiCatalogue's own `query` input does filter server-side, so this port calls it live instead.

island-content.name: island.is public web content — guides, life events, organization pages
island-content.publisher: Stafrænt Ísland (Digital Iceland) and individual government organizations publishing through island.is
island-content.notes: Same undocumented GraphQL layer as island-catalogue, different queries (getSingleArticle, searchResults). Editorial/informational content (e.g. 'Sækja um vegabréf' — how to apply for a passport, fees, required documents) — not law, no authority-class. Query names/fields aren't visible in browser network traffic (server-rendered pages) — found via Apollo Server's schema-validation error messages ('did you mean X?'), which remain informative with introspection disabled. get_island_article currently resolves full text for type='Article' only; LifeEventPage/Manual/OrganizationSubpage show up in search but would need their own getSingle... query found the same way to get full text.
